title: Sonatine
identity: Dubois's Sonatine is the Leduc AL23742 alto saxophone/piano work, distinct from Deuxième Sonatine (AL23963). The Royal Conservatoire Antwerp list dates Sonatine to 1966 and gives an eight-minute duration; a retailer matches AL23742 to the title. The 1968 date belongs to the separate Deuxième Sonatine and should not be applied here.

evidence.claim: Royal Conservatoire Antwerp library list identifies Sonatine AL23742, 1966, eight minutes, dedicated to François Daneels.
Retailer identifies AL23742 as Dubois's Sonatine for alto saxophone and piano; date was not independently confirmed there.
Windmusic records a distinct Deuxième Sonatine as AL23963, an exam work, 1968, 12 pages plus separate parts.

review_focus: Inference: a conservatory library’s duration and contest note make formal pacing relevant; the distinct second sonatina is a separate work.
collection_flag: Published saxophone/piano sonatina with library-listed conservatory contest use.
gaps: No score or recording inspected; verify date and dedication against Leduc's primary score page if available.
proposed_corrections: Retain 1966 for Sonatine AL23742 from the conservatory library list. Keep 1968 attached to the distinct Deuxième Sonatine AL23963.
